ReadNest
Your whole library, one cozy nest
ReadNest finds your EPUBs, PDFs, comics and documents, and keeps them organized by author, series and collections. No sign-up needed.
Scan or import in seconds
Grant a folder once and we index every supported file — or just pick files manually. Your books stay on your device.
A reader that feels like paper
Warm themes, beautiful serif type, bookmarks, highlights, notes, dictionary and read-aloud. Day, Sepia, Night, Console and OLED.
Quotes & notes, all in one place
Everything you highlight across every book lands in one searchable hub. Export and revisit your best lines anytime.
